case.summary: An internal fraud investigation determined that card C09933-K2 was compromised through an account takeover, resulting in an exposure of $148.89. The verdict of fraud is supported by a case-memory model score of 0.740 and historical data showing that eight of the eight most similar closed cases were confirmed fraud, compounded by a previous compromise 45 days prior. Although the transaction amount and billing region were familiar to the card, the cumulative risk indicators confirmed malicious activity. Following this determination, the system automatically created a case, and the L1 human approval process is required to block the card.
